name: Behenui
description: Behenui was a planet in the fifth orbit around the star Beheboth. It was the only gas giant in the Beheboth system, which was located in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Behenui itself was circled by nine moons.
